limits: Public development briefs are not sealed holdouts. No comparative or human results exist. Create unseen briefs separately before generalization claims.

sharedContract.data: Invented benchmark data only; no real payments, messages or production resources.
sharedContract.assets: Use an equal pre-approved asset pack per paired run, record provenance; if no pack exists both conditions use the same code-native/owned material.
sharedContract.implementation: One representative entry and one complete local flow with defined failure state; same stack/runtime per pair.
sharedContract.conditions: Freeze exact skill/model versions, seed where supported, prompts, data, assets, tools, time/token/spend limits, captures and permitted retries in a hashed run manifest before generation.
sharedContract.comparison: Baseline vs proposed. Original Design Taste only on marketing briefs; platform-guided baseline elsewhere.
sharedContract.review: Randomized anonymous A/B with ties; independent reviewers; no builder rationale until decisions recorded.
sharedContract.cost: Declare total spend and iteration caps before running. No implicit paid-generation or participant authorization.

briefs.task: Find the service for a slipping gear and begin an enquiry.
briefs.success: Correct service/price identifiable and selected details reach enquiry without invented proof.

briefs.task: Find dates, cost and accessibility information, then inspect application requirements.
content: Step-free ground floor; upstairs studio has stairs
briefs.success: Dates, total cost and access limitations remain prominent and truthful.

briefs.task: Reserve a camera for 3–5 November 2027, recover when unavailable.
briefs.success: Unavailable equipment cannot be confirmed; price/deposit and dates survive recovery.

briefs.task: Locate a project and request access to a restricted document.
briefs.success: User distinguishes missing result from denied access; no privilege escalation or false grant.

briefs.task: Respond to a visitor after denied microphone permission without claiming a call connected.
content: No public phone numbers or presence
briefs.success: Alternative contact is discoverable; private details stay hidden and pending is not success.

briefs.task: Capture a note offline and resolve failed synchronization.
briefs.success: Draft persists and local storage is distinguishable from remote synchronization.

briefs.task: Open two documents, compare them and handle unsaved close.
briefs.success: Document identity/focus stays clear; unsaved work is not silently lost.

briefs.task: Find an image, inspect metadata and recover a missing source.
briefs.success: Selection and metadata remain associated; relinking updates the intended fixture only.

briefs.task: Identify low stock, filter one site and inspect an item.
content: One missing count and one genuine zero
briefs.success: Zero and unknown differ; filter context and item/site identity persist.

briefs.task: Find a failed contact attempt and inspect its event sequence.
briefs.success: Timeline explains the selected failure without false live/connected indicators.

briefs.task: Read objective, pause, change text scale and resume.
content: Settings with text scale and motion
briefs.success: Menus use predictable focus; settings remain reachable and HUD does not obscure play.

briefs.task: Compare two items, equip one and return to play.
briefs.success: Attributes and selected slot are clear; capacity error preserves choice and return focus.

craft.scale: 1=unclear/inconsistent; 3=coherent and adequate; 5=exceptionally specific and resolved; 2/4 intermediate; cite screenshot evidence

use.note: Record reviewer role and actual users separately; scripted task pass is not user research.

technical.gate: Any unresolved critical-task failure prevents a release recommendation; no overall score can hide it.

reviewProtocol: Freeze and hash run manifest before building.
Keep all failures and costs; equal retry budget.
Capture comparable entry, task and failure states.
Randomize anonymous labels and retain hidden mapping.
Use two independent critics; record ties and disagreement.
Separate model critique, human craft review and intended-user tasks.
Report per-brief results and limits, never an invented aggregate study.
Create separate unseen holdouts before generalization claims.
